easyPrerequisites: Mardu Siegebreaker must be exiled by Glorious Protector, and Worldgorger Dragon must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Worldgorger Dragon for its mana cost.
When Worldgorger Dragon enters, it exiles Glorious Protector until Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Worldgorger Dragon's ETB.
When Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield, Mardu Siegebreaker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it exiles Worldgorger Dragon until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Mardu Siegebreaker's ETB.
When Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, Glorious Protector is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Glorious Protector enters, it exiles Mardu Siegebreaker until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Glorious Protector's ETB.
When Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, Worldgorger Dragon is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
